subject: Seating matrix and feature-pack optimization for Medisys
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@medisys.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@medisys.ai
Date: 2027-12-01T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Initial: packaging options + seat shuffle question

Hi Jonas,

We're reviewing the current pilot and sizing for next year and have two asks: first, we want guidance on whether to upgrade a subset of users to the Pro tier vs buy add-on features for our triage workflows; second, our customer success team needs an approach for reassigning seats across teams mid-contract (we'll migrate ~120 seats between engineering and support in Q2).

Can you share a recommended seating matrix and a few price/discount scenarios (annual vs monthly billing) that preserve ROI for us? Also please call out any limitations on moving seats between seat pools and whether feature bundles carry over during reassignment.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Medisys

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@medisys.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-02T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: packaging options + seat shuffle question

Hi Samir — thanks for the context. Short answer: we recommend a mixed approach — upgrade a focused set of heavy-usage users to Pro, and keep lightweight seats on Standard with feature add-ons for workloads like triage. I've attached a seating matrix and a one-page pricing snapshot for three scenarios (status quo, partial upgrade, full Pro swap).

Key constraints to note:
- Seats can be reassigned between teams during the term, but seats retain their current plan unless you request a plan-change assignment (which we can process at the next billing cycle).
- Feature bundles (e.g., low-latency routing + advanced observability) are licensed per-seat. When you move a seat, the applied feature entitlements move with it unless removed by an admin.
- For mid-term plan upgrades we prorate remaining months; downgrades are applied at next renewal.

Deliverables I attached:
- medisys_seating_matrix_v1.csv (proposed seat distribution + estimated token consumption)
- Medisys_MA_proposal_v1.pdf (pricing scenarios + recommended discount ladders)

Next step: if you want, we can lock in scenario B (partial upgrade for 35 seats to Pro + feature add-on bundle for Support) with a 12-month annual commitment and a 10% commitment discount. I'll loop in finance for approval paths.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: contracts@medisys.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@medisys.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-03T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: packaging options + seat shuffle question

Jonas — a couple quick procurement clarifications before we escalate:
1) If Medisys commits to a 24-month term for scenario B, what additional discount (if any) do you offer beyond the 10% annual?
2) Are there any restrictions or fees when seats move between billing entities (we may move 20 seats to a wholly-owned subsidiary in month 9)?

Appreciate specifics so our procurement team can sign off.

— Medisys Contracts

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, contracts@medisys.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-07T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: packaging options + seat shuffle question

On Tue, Dec 3, 2027 at 08:46 AM Medisys Contracts wrote:
> Jonas — a couple quick procurement clarifications before we escalate:
> 1) If Medisys commits to a 24-month term for scenario B, what additional discount (if any) do you offer beyond the 10% annual?
> 2) Are there any restrictions or fees when seats move between billing entities (we may move 20 seats to a wholly-owned subsidiary in month 9)?

Samir / Contracts — we can support both asks. Pricing summary:
- 12-month, partial-upgrade (scenario B): 10% commitment discount on base seats.
- 24-month commitment: an additional 7% multi-year bonus (stacking to ~16% net on base seats).
- Seat transfers between legal entities are allowed once per transfer window; transfers that change billing entity require a short SOW and a $1,500 admin processing fee (covers invoicing changes and tax/PO updates).

Operational notes: feature add-ons follow the seat. If a seat transfers to another legal entity during term, entitlements carry but invoicing follows the new entity after the transfer request is processed.

I've added Ben for sign-off on the processing fee and Laura on billing mechanics.

Thanks,
Priyom
Principal, Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@medisys.ai>, contracts@medisys.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-11T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: packaging options + seat shuffle question

Samir — following up with final confirmation.

Quick recap and recommendation:
- We recommend scenario B: upgrade 35 engineers to Pro, keep 85 seats on Standard + triage add-on for Support.
- Pricing: 12-month annual commit = 10% discount; 24-month commit = 16% total (10% + 7% multi-year).
- Seat transfer policy: allowed; one transfer window per quarter. Transfers that change the billing/legal entity require a $1,500 admin SOW.
- Downgrade policy: downgrades take effect at renewal; upgrades are prorated immediately.

If that works, I'll send a clean proposal (licensed seats + SOW for the transfer admin fee) for signature and start date Jan 1, 2028. Attached are the two files referenced earlier.

Next action: Samir to confirm scenario choice and term length.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
